one_sentence: The nine Fruits of the Spirit form a coherence bundle whose full operation produces an invariance the adversary cannot attack.
executive_summary: This document argues that the nine Fruits of the Spirit (love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control) are not independent virtues but a unified coherence bundle, analogous to CPT symmetry in physics. The key structural claim is that these Fruits co-emerge and co-decay as a system; compromising any single Fruit exposes a joint through which the adversary can propagate damage across the entire bundle. The conclusion is that spiritual formation should not focus on strengthening individual weaknesses but on reinstating the full bundle simultaneously by opening the channel to the Spirit (s = +1), producing an invulnerable state with no attack surface.
short_summary: This document is a theological-physics analysis of the nine Fruits of the Spirit as a coherence bundle. The core structural claim is that the Fruits are not independent but form a unified system where attack on one propagates to all. Key evidence includes the bundle property, the analogy to CPT invariance, and the adversary's targeted pressure on exposed joints. This matters because it reframes spiritual formation from fixing individual weaknesses to receiving the full bundle, producing an invulnerable state.
